title.zh: OpenAI前研究主管转战工厂Agent：融资2.32亿美元，10小时工作压至15分钟
title.en: OpenAI前研究主管转战工厂Agent：融资2.32亿美元，10小时工作压至15分钟

current_state.zh: Arda, the manufacturing-engineering AI agent startup founded by former OpenAI chief research officer Bob McGrew, launched with a $160M Series A at a $1.5B valuation, bringing total funding to $232M, and is already deployed at Anduril's ArsenalOS manufacturing system where it cuts basic work-instruction writing from 10 hours to 15 minutes.
